claim_being_audited: Whether model-card certification for the current release is compliant because aggregate readiness passed, launch rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and current-release documentation can support deployment despite a student aid advising segment weakness.
decision_criteria: Compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Compliant only if the material student aid advising weakness is either explicitly disclosed in the current release documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may inform context but cannot satisfy the current-evidence requirement.
Absent proof of those predicates, certification should not be treated as fully supported.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or certification document showing the present evaluation results for this release.
Provide the exact disclosure text for the student aid advising weakness in the current release documentation.
Provide approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance if certification is being justified without full remediation.
Provide evidence linking the current eval batch and retrieval configuration to the release being certified, so the documentation predicate can be verified.
specific_concerns: The governing policy allows certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation.
The actor summary itself says the student aid advising slice is below the warning threshold and that no approved mitigation or owner acceptance is attached.

The actor relies on a conditional theory of compliance ('supportable only if current release documentation reflects the present evaluation results and explicitly discloses the weakness') without providing admissible evidence that this condition is actually satisfied.
Prior approval is expressly described as stale context and cannot substitute for current-release support under the policy.
Informal monitoring comments are acknowledged not to be reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance.
unsupported_claims: The recommended action to certify the model is not fully supported because there is no admissible evidence here that the current release documentation already reflects the current eval batch and expressly discloses the student aid advising weakness.
Any implication that public governance guidance alone is sufficient to satisfy the repository's specific certification policy is unsupported.
Any implication that aggregate readiness and a clean rehearsal overcome the need for current documentation or approved mitigation for a material segment weakness is unsupported.
